profile.what: Holding company of the Godrej Industries Group (GIG) with its own oleochemicals business. Owns 23.7% of Godrej Consumer Products (associate), 44.8% of Godrej Properties and 65.1% of Godrej Agrovet (listed subsidiaries), 100% of Godrej Investment Ltd (which holds ~91% of Godrej Capital, an unlisted housing-finance and MSME lender), Godrej International trading entities, and an estate-management business (Godrej One, Vikhroli).
profile.chemicals: Oleochemicals and surfactants from palm, palm-kernel and rapeseed oil: fatty acids (~35% of FY26 chemicals revenue), fatty alcohols (~21%), surfactants SLES/SLS/AOS (~22%), glycerine (~10%), specialty esters, waxes and food additives (~11%), early-stage biosurfactants. Plants at Valia (Gujarat), Ambernath (Maharashtra), Kundaim (Goa, food additives acquired Apr-2025) and Kheda (Gujarat, ethoxylation unit acquired). Exports to ~70 countries: Rs1,145 cr in FY26 (+20%), 28% of revenue. Volumes +9.4% in FY26; specialty volumes +37%. Pioneered oleochemicals in India in 1963.

godrejCapital.aumTarget: Rs1 lakh crore (no date given in the PTI report)
godrejCapital.structure: On 28-Jan-2026 GIL transferred its entire Godrej Capital stake (389,775 shares) at cost (Rs3,862.69 cr) to Godrej Investment Ltd, a 100% subsidiary incorporated on 5-Jan-2026 as a core investment company. Godrej Wealth & Asset Management Ltd was incorporated under GINVL on 4-Feb-2026. The AGM (13-Aug-2026) sought approval for up to Rs1,000 cr more investment in GINVL.

Godrej Investment cost Rs3,913 cr -> Rs4,283 cr

godrejCapital.rightsPriceNote: FY26 rights at Rs693.91 cr / 37,559 shares = Rs184,750 a share; 389,775 GIL shares are ~91.1% -> ~427,800 shares in issue -> ~Rs7,900 cr post-money, ~1.8x Mar-26 book. A rights issue to a parent is not a market price.
godrejCapital.plan: PTI 22-Apr-2026: the group has invested Rs5,000 cr in Godrej Capital and will invest Rs5,000-7,000 cr in its unlisted businesses over five years; Godrej Capital and chemicals are the 'front-runners' for listing within five years; management put the two unlisted businesses at about Rs25,000 cr.

history.event: Company incorporated (CIN year); earlier name history not verified from a dated source (see gaps)
GPL stake 49.4% (Mar-20) -> 44.8% (Mar-21, after GPL's equity raise) -> 47.3% (Jun-21, GIL invests ~Rs1,000 cr; cost Rs762 cr -> Rs1,761 cr)
Pyxis Holdings (later Godrej Capital) appears in GIL's investments at Rs662 cr cost, 85.3% held
GAVL stake raised to 64.9% (cost Rs810 cr -> Rs1,043 cr); chemicals record year (revenue Rs4,173 cr, PBIT Rs697 cr)
Chemicals revenue -35% to Rs2,697 cr, PBIT Rs254 cr; consolidated EPS Rs1.78

Godrej family settlement: group split into Godrej Industries Group (Adi, Nadir, Tanya, Pirojsha, Nisaba Godrej: GIL, GCPL, GPL, GAVL, Astec) and Godrej Enterprises Group (Jamshyd Godrej, Nyrika Holkar: Godrej & Boyce and affiliates, incl. the Vikhroli land); separate brand and non-compete agreement; no royalty for the brand
GPL raises equity; GIL invests (~Rs950 cr; cost Rs1,780 cr -> Rs2,732 cr) but its stake falls to 44.8%
Godrej Foundation sells 3.33% of GIL in a block deal to promoter entities (Godrej Seeds & Genetics, Anamudi Real Estates LLP): promoter group 71.3% -> 74.64%; Foundation 13.37% -> 10.04%
Godrej Capital moved under Godrej Investment Ltd (100% subsidiary) at cost

Board: Nadir Godrej to retire as Chairman & MD on 13-Aug-2026 (Chairman Emeritus with Adi Godrej); Pirojsha Godrej Chairperson-designate, Chairperson of GIL and GIG from 14-Aug-2026; Burjis Godrej joins the board

Group vision: listed group market value from ~Rs1.6 lakh cr to over Rs5 lakh cr in five years; list two of Godrej Capital, chemicals and Godrej Ventures; targets 15% sales growth, 20% EPS growth, 18% ROE for each business
Rs370 cr more into Godrej Investment (Godrej Capital)
